lines.text: The LORD has Moses collect twelve staffs, one per tribe leader, with Aaron's name written on the staff of Levi.
Moses places the staffs in the Tent of Meeting, and the chosen man's staff will turn into a snake.
Moses puts Aaron's staff back in front of the Testimony as a sign for the rebellious, lest they be scattered.
The Israelites cry out that they are perishing, that anyone near the tabernacle will die, and ask if all will perish.

problems.problem: Its wrong detail "in front of the golden calf" is 6 words. Swap one short detail (4 words or fewer, like a name, place or number) and list only the swapped words.
Its true detail "so they will not die" isn't in Numbers 17:10 word for word.
Its wrong detail "so the people will not be enslaved" is 7 words. Swap one short detail (4 words or fewer, like a name, place or number) and list only the swapped words.
The Israelites’ question about whether they will all perish is still omitted.
